name: iLoveMyFiles
description: Free, private browser-based file tools for images and PDFs. All processing happens locally in your browser — no uploads, no sign-up required.

resources.name: Merge PDFs
resources.description: Combine multiple PDF files into one document directly in your browser.

resources.name: Split PDF
resources.description: Extract page ranges or save pages individually from a PDF.

resources.name: Delete PDF Pages
resources.description: Remove unwanted pages from a PDF document.

resources.name: Rotate PDF Pages
resources.description: Turn all or selected pages of a PDF clockwise or anticlockwise.

resources.name: Resize PDF Pages
resources.description: Change PDF page size to A4, A3, Letter and more.

resources.name: Remove PDF Metadata
resources.description: Inspect and clear PDF document properties such as title, author and keywords.

resources.name: Compress PDF
resources.description: Reduce PDF file size with three quality levels.

resources.name: Images to PDF
resources.description: Combine one or many images into a single PDF document.

resources.name: Add Page Numbers
resources.description: Stamp page numbers on every page of a PDF.

resources.name: Watermark PDF
resources.description: Add a diagonal text watermark to every page of a PDF.

resources.name: Image Converter
resources.description: Convert images between JPG, PNG, WebP, BMP, GIF, ICO, SVG and TIFF.

resources.name: Image Compressor
resources.description: Reduce image file size with a quality slider or target KB.

resources.name: Image Resizer
resources.description: Resize images to exact pixel dimensions, optionally keeping aspect ratio.

resources.name: Crop Image
resources.description: Drag to select the exact area of an image to keep.

resources.name: Rotate & Flip Image
resources.description: Turn images 90°/180°/270° and mirror them horizontally or vertically.

resources.name: Watermark Image
resources.description: Add text watermarks to images.

resources.name: PDF to Images
resources.description: Render each PDF page as a PNG or JPG image.

resources.name: Organize PDF Pages
resources.description: Reorder, duplicate or remove pages from a PDF.

resources.name: JSON Formatter
resources.description: Format, minify and validate JSON.

resources.name: Base64 Encoder
resources.description: Encode text to Base64 or decode it back.

resources.name: Hash Generator
resources.description: Create SHA-256, SHA-384 or SHA-512 hashes from text or files.

resources.name: Word Counter
resources.description: Count words, characters, lines and reading time.

resources.name: JSON ↔ CSV
resources.description: Convert JSON arrays to CSV and back.

resources.name: Unit Converter
resources.description: Convert data size, length, mass and time units.

resources.name: OCR
resources.description: Extract selectable text from images or PDFs.

resources.name: QR Code Generator
resources.description: Create a QR code PNG from any link or text.

resources.name: Barcode Generator
resources.description: Create Code 128, EAN-13 and more barcodes as PNG.

resources.name: Flatten PDF
resources.description: Render pages to images so text is no longer selectable.

resources.name: Make PDF Searchable
resources.description: Add an invisible, selectable text layer to scanned PDFs with OCR.

resources.name: CBSE Result Analyzer
resources.description: Read a CBSE school or roll-number-wise result gazette and turn it into subject-wise marks, a pass percentage with a stated denominator, grade distributions, compartment statistics and downloadable reports. The interactive analyzer is offered to visitors in India; the guide is open to everyone.
